routes.label: Previous tosses do not change the next toss

question: A fair coin has landed heads up on 5 consecutive tosses. What is the probability of heads on the 6th toss? (Express the result as a fraction in simplest form.)
solution: Each toss is independent. Previous outcomes do not change the probabilities of later outcomes, so the probability of heads on the 6th toss is still \(1/2\).
